INTRO.TITLE: Hey, I'm Calisto
INTRO.DESCRIPTION:
Full Stack Web Developer from Barranquilla, Colombia.
+2 years of experience building modern web, desktop, and mobile products with strong focus on architecture & scalability. Currently leading the web evolution at EvolvePos.

ITEMS.TITLE: Full Stack Developer (Frontend-focused)
ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: Led the strategic migration of legacy POS software to a scalable web platform built from scratch. Designed a reusable component library using Tailwind CSS and Radix UI, significantly accelerating team development cycles. Architected a cross-platform launcher with Electron.js for automated software distribution.

ITEMS.TITLE: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Trainer
ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: Trained AI models to optimize content organization and rewriting, evaluating and improving accuracy in text, audio, and image projects. Provided structured feedback to adjust models for natural language processing, speech recognition, and computer vision.

ITEMS.TITLE: Freelance Web Developer
ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: Designed and implemented custom web solutions, including a poetry blog that increased a client's follower base by 30%. Improved performance of platforms like EDUSAC for SoftRivus S.A.S. using strategies like Conventional Commits and Node.js to optimize development time.

ITEMS.TITLE: Systems Technician
ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: Performed maintenance and repair on over 90 computers, optimizing technical support processes and significantly reducing failures over a 3-month period, ensuring continuous system operation.

moodflix.title: Moodflix - Movie recommendations based on your mood
moodflix.description: An AI-powered movie recommendation app. It suggests movies that match your mood. Created from scratch using Gemini and Next.js.

jadirh.title: Jadirh Gonzalez Poems - Poetry Blog
jadirh.description: A poetry blog that I designed and developed for a client passionate about writing. Fans can explore, comment on, and like Jadirh's poems. Created and designed from scratch by me.

travlog.description: Built from a community Figma design, initially designed for desktop. I adapted it for mobile devices and developed it using AstroJS.

ABOUT.TITLE: A bit about me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION_1: I am Carlos Bolaño, though my friends call me Calisto. I’m a Full Stack Developer with a Product Owner mindset and over 2 years of experience building scalable digital ecosystems. Currently, I lead the strategic web evolution at EvolvePOS, where I architected the migration of mission-critical legacy systems into high-performance web platforms.
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION_2: My technical edge is defined by a deep mastery of Clean Architecture and SOLID principles. Beyond bridging the gap between complex backends and fluid interfaces, I contributed to the advancement of world-class AI models—including Google Gemini and Meta’s Ollama during my time at Outlier. This unique background allows me to merge traditional engineering excellence with the next generation of intelligent software.
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION_3: Whether I’m designing cross-platform desktop solutions with Electron.js or launching mobile products like 4xMil, my focus is absolute ownership of the outcome. I don’t just ship features; I solve business problems with engineering precision. From increasing a client's audience by 30% to leading complex software migrations, I build software that is as robust as it is impactful.
